lines.trans: Phew! My heart nearly jumped right over the lemon tree!
It was only the neighbour from the bookshop next door with our mail!
Read the stamped official envelope she handed you, Clara.
Neighbourhood heritage café review: Wednesday at three o'clock sharp.
Thank goodness it is not tonight! Read the checklist inside, Clara!

words.gloss: to be (identity, origin, time, permanent trait)

lines.trans: Item one: clear street sign and open courtyard access for neighbours.
Street gate oiled and wooden sign painted: check.
Item two: bright, safe indoor room with hot tea and fresh food.
Twelve chairs, clean windows, new copper wire, and two mysterious white jars!
Put labels on them right now before anyone sleeps, Clara.
Left spoon... sweet! Right spoon... salty as the sea! Red labels on both!
Crisis averted! Everyone to bed: six o'clock comes fast!

Read the stamped official envelope she handed you, Clara.

Thank goodness it is not tonight! Read the checklist inside, Clara!

Street gate oiled and wooden sign painted: check.
Item two: bright, safe indoor room with hot tea and fresh food.
Twelve chairs, clean windows, new copper wire, and two mysterious white jars!

Left spoon... sweet! Right spoon... salty as the sea! Red labels on both!

Read the stamped official envelope she handed you, Clara.

words.gloss: to be (identity, origin, time, permanent trait)

lines.trans: Item one: clear street sign and open courtyard access for neighbours.
Street gate oiled and wooden sign painted: check.
Item two: bright, safe indoor room with hot tea and fresh food.
Twelve chairs, clean windows, new copper wire, and two mysterious white jars!
Put labels on them right now before anyone sleeps, Clara.
Left spoon... sweet! Right spoon... salty as the sea! Red labels on both!
Crisis averted! Everyone to bed: six o'clock comes fast!
Good night!

meanings.note: Marks destination, clock time, and animate direct objects (personal a).

examples.text: Vamos a la estación ahora.
examples.trans: We are going to the station now.

examples.text: El desayuno empieza a las ocho.
examples.trans: Breakfast starts at eight o'clock.

meanings.note: Regular -ir verb with irregular past participle abierto.

examples.text: Abro la ventana por la mañana.
examples.trans: I open the window in the morning.

examples.text: Ayer abrimos la tienda temprano.
examples.trans: Yesterday we opened the shop early.

meanings.note: Ahora mismo means 'right now'.

examples.text: Voy para allá ahora mismo.
examples.trans: I am heading there right now.

examples.text: Ahora tenemos cuatro mesas libres.
examples.trans: Now we have four free tables.

meanings.note: Mandatory contraction of preposition a + masculine article el; al + infinitive means 'upon doing'.

examples.text: Vamos al mercado por la mañana.
examples.trans: We go to the market in the morning.

examples.text: Al abrir la puerta, sonó el timbre.
examples.trans: Upon opening the door, the bell rang.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender with the two items it refers to: ambos (masculine/mixed) and ambas (feminine).

examples.text: Pegamos etiquetas rojas en ambos tarros de cristal.
examples.trans: We stuck red labels on both glass jars.

examples.text: Conozco a los dos hermanos y ambos cocinan muy bien.
examples.trans: I know both brothers and both of them cook very well.

meanings.note: Antes de means 'before' a noun or infinitive.

examples.text: Llegué diez minutos antes.
examples.trans: I arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: Antes de salir, cierra la ventana.
examples.trans: Before leaving, close the window.

meanings.note: Local city district with its own shops and squares.

examples.text: El barrio está aquí.
examples.trans: The neighbourhood is here.

examples.text: Vemos los barrios desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the neighbourhoods from the door.

meanings.note: Quedarse blanco means 'to go pale'.

examples.text: Es una pieza blanca.
examples.trans: It is a white piece.

examples.text: Mira, hay un sobre blanco doblado en el asa.
examples.trans: Look, there is a folded white envelope on the handle.

meanings.note: Shortens to buen before masculine singular nouns (buen viaje); ¡Buenos días! = Good morning!

examples.text: ¡Buenos días a todos!
examples.trans: Good morning, everyone!

examples.text: Hace muy buen tiempo hoy.
examples.trans: The weather is very nice today.

meanings.note: Electrical cord or wire.

examples.text: El cable está aquí.
examples.trans: The cord is here.

examples.text: Vemos los cables desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the cords from the door.

meanings.note: Plural los cafés (two coffees = dos cafés).

examples.text: El café está aquí.
examples.trans: The coffee is here.

examples.text: Vemos los cafés desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the coffees from the door.

meanings.note: Describes hot drinks, food, or water.

examples.text: Es una pieza caliente.
examples.trans: It is a hot piece.

examples.text: Aquí tiene, señora: té caliente de menta con miel.
examples.trans: Here you are, madam: hot mint tea with honey.

meanings.note: Feminine noun: la calle.

examples.text: La calle está aquí.
examples.trans: The street is here.

examples.text: Vemos las calles desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the streets from the door.

meanings.note: Hacer la cama = to make the bed.

examples.text: La cama está aquí.
examples.trans: The bed is here.

examples.text: Vemos las camas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the beds from the door.

meanings.note: Shopfront sign or notice board.

examples.text: El cartel está aquí.
examples.trans: The sign is here.

examples.text: Vemos los carteles desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the signs from the door.

meanings.note: Placed before the word it modifies.

examples.text: Ya son casi las doce.
examples.trans: It is almost twelve o'clock already.

examples.text: Casi olvido la llave en la mesa.
examples.trans: I nearly forgot the key on the table.

meanings.note: Alto y claro = loud and clear; ¡Claro! / ¡Pues claro! = Of course!

examples.text: El mensaje es alto y claro.
examples.trans: The message is loud and clear.

examples.text: ¡Pues claro que puedes pasar!
examples.trans: Well of course you can come in!

meanings.note: Used for hot-water pipes and cookware.

examples.text: El cobre es muy importante aquí.
examples.trans: The copper is very important here.

examples.text: Hablamos sobre el cobre.
examples.trans: We talk about the copper.

examples.text: Es la comida más importante del día.
examples.trans: It is the most important meal of the day.

examples.text: Yo comida
examples.trans: I comida

meanings.note: Unaccented como compares or gives a reason (distinct from interrogative cómo).

examples.text: Está fría como el agua del río.
examples.trans: It is as cold as river water.

examples.text: Todo funciona como debe ser.
examples.trans: Everything works just as it should.

meanings.note: Combines with mí/ti to form conmigo ('with me') and contigo ('with you').

examples.text: Tomo café con leche caliente.
examples.trans: I take coffee with hot milk.

examples.text: Habla con calma, por favor.
examples.trans: Speak calmly, please.

meanings.note: Plural corazones.

examples.text: El corazón está aquí.
examples.trans: The heart is here.

examples.text: Vemos los corazones desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the hearts from the door.

examples.text: El correo es de ayer.
examples.trans: The email is from yesterday.

examples.text: Tengo cien correos nuevos.
examples.trans: I have a hundred new emails.

meanings.en: crisis, slump, rough patch (professional, personal, or economic)
meanings.note: Feminine noun that is invariable in the plural ('una crisis' / 'varias crisis'). Often used without an article after 'en' ('estar en crisis').

examples.text: Porque estamos en crisis y vuelta a empezar todo desde cero.
examples.trans: Because we're in a crisis, and it's back to starting everything from scratch.

examples.text: La agencia superó una grave crisis cuando su actriz estrella se marchó.
examples.trans: The agency overcame a serious crisis when its star actress walked out.

meanings.note: Table or soup spoon; cucharita is a teaspoon.

examples.text: Pon una cuchara limpia junto a cada cuenco.
examples.trans: Set a clean spoon beside each bowl.

examples.text: Prueba la sopa de lentejas con esta cuchara.
examples.trans: Taste the lentil soup with this spoon.

dar.gloss: to give; to face onto (dar a); to strike (the hour)

meanings.en: to give; to face onto (dar a); to strike (the hour)
meanings.note: Irregular 1st sg doy and preterite di/dio; dar las doce = strike twelve.

examples.text: La ventana da al patio soleado.
examples.trans: The window looks out onto the sunny courtyard.

examples.text: El reloj acaba de dar las doce.
examples.trans: The clock has just struck twelve.

meanings.note: Links possession, origin, material (de madera), and contents (taza de té).

examples.text: Es una mesa redonda de madera.
examples.trans: It is a round wooden table.

examples.text: Vengo de la estación de tren.
examples.trans: I am coming from the train station.

meanings.note: Mandatory contraction of preposition de + masculine article el.

examples.text: El bizcocho acaba de salir del horno.
examples.trans: The cake just came out of the oven.

examples.text: Soy vecino del barrio.
examples.trans: I am a neighbour from the quarter.

meanings.note: Dentro de + time means 'in (after) a certain amount of time'.

examples.text: Hay cuatro mesas dentro.
examples.trans: There are four tables inside.

examples.text: Vuelvo dentro de diez minutos.
examples.trans: I will be back in ten minutes.

meanings.note: A la derecha / a mano derecha = on the right.

examples.text: La derecha está aquí.
examples.trans: The right is here.

examples.text: Vemos las derechas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the rights from the door.

meanings.note: Las doce = twelve o'clock.

examples.text: El reloj da las doce al mediodía.
examples.trans: The clock strikes twelve at noon.

examples.text: Aquí tienes doce euros de cambio.
examples.trans: Here is twelve euros in change.

meanings.note: Stem-changing verb (o -> ue in present: duermo; o -> u in preterite 3rd: durmió).

examples.text: Duermo ocho horas cada noche.
examples.trans: I sleep eight hours every night.

examples.text: Anoche dormí de maravilla aquí.
examples.trans: Last night I slept wonderfully here.

meanings.note: Los dos / las dos means 'both'.

examples.text: Pongo dos tazas azules en la mesa.
examples.trans: I put two blue cups on the table.

examples.text: Compra las dos válvulas por favor.
examples.trans: Buy both valves, please.

meanings.note: Same form for masculine and feminine; los dulces = sweets/pastries.

examples.text: Es una pieza dulce.
examples.trans: It is a sweet piece.

examples.text: ¿Podemos servir mantequilla salada con mermelada dulce de fresa?
examples.trans: Can we serve salted butter with sweet strawberry jam?

meanings.note: Definite article; also appears before feminine nouns starting with stressed /a/ (el agua, el asa).

examples.text: El patio tiene mucha luz.
examples.trans: The courtyard has plenty of light.

examples.text: Pásame el libro de reservas.
examples.trans: Pass me the reservation book.

meanings.note: Expresses location inside or on top of a surface (en la mesa = on the table).

examples.text: Las tazas están en la mesa.
examples.trans: The cups are on the table.

examples.text: Vivimos en Valencia todo el año.
examples.trans: We live in Valencia all year.

meanings.note: Por encima = on top / over the surface.

examples.text: Pon azúcar glas por encima.
examples.trans: Put powdered sugar on top.

examples.text: Hay un cartel encima de la puerta.
examples.trans: There is a sign above the door.

meanings.note: Used both for oiling hinges/locks and for buttering baking tins (engrasar el molde).

examples.text: Mateo engrasó los goznes del portón para quitar el ruido.
examples.trans: Mateo oiled the gate hinges to stop the noise.

examples.text: Antes de verter la masa, hay que engrasar bien la bandeja.
examples.trans: Before pouring the batter, you have to grease the tray well.

meanings.note: Written as one word in modern Spanish.

examples.text: Subo el desayuno enseguida.
examples.trans: I will bring breakfast up right away.

examples.text: Enseguida vuelvo con la llave.
examples.trans: I will be right back with the key.

meanings.note: Doorway or entrance hall.

examples.text: La entrada está aquí.
examples.trans: The entrance is here.

examples.text: Vemos las entradas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the entrances from the door.

meanings.note: Forms: este (m sg), esta (f sg), estos (m pl), estas (f pl).

examples.text: Este patio es muy tranquilo.
examples.trans: This courtyard is very quiet.

examples.text: Esta mañana hace mucho sol.
examples.trans: This morning it is very sunny.

meanings.note: Luggage tag or bottle label.

examples.text: La etiqueta está aquí.
examples.trans: The tag is here.

examples.text: Vemos las etiquetas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the tags from the door.

meanings.note: Pintura fresca = wet paint; agua fresca = cool water.

examples.text: Es una pieza fresca.
examples.trans: It is a cool piece.

examples.text: Bien. Pon estas hierbas frescas por encima antes de servirlos.
examples.trans: Good. Put these fresh herbs on top before serving them.

meanings.note: Describes heritage buildings and old quarters.

examples.text: Es una pieza histórica.
examples.trans: It is a historic piece.

examples.text: ¡Un arquitecto que trabaja con patios históricos por toda Valencia!
examples.trans: An architect who works with historic courtyard buildings all over Valencia!

meanings.note: A la izquierda = on/to the left.

examples.text: La izquierda está aquí.
examples.trans: The left is here.

examples.text: Vemos las izquierdas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the lefts from the door.

meanings.note: Definite feminine singular article before nouns; direct-object feminine pronoun before/attached to verbs.

examples.text: La puerta del patio es azul.
examples.trans: The courtyard door is blue.

examples.text: La habitación tiene mucha luz.
examples.trans: The room has plenty of light.

meanings.note: Al lado = on the side / next door.

examples.text: El lado está aquí.
examples.trans: The side is here.

examples.text: Vemos los lados desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the sides from the door.

meanings.note: Used with feminine plural nouns and clock hours (las ocho).

examples.text: Las ventanas dan al jardín.
examples.trans: The windows face the garden.

examples.text: Desayunamos a las ocho.
examples.trans: We have breakfast at eight.

meanings.note: Preterite 3rd sg/pl spells y: leyó, leyeron; past participle leído.

examples.text: Leo el periódico con el primer café.
examples.trans: I read the newspaper with my first coffee.

examples.text: Anoche leímos toda la carta juntos.
examples.trans: Last night we read the whole letter together.

meanings.note: In Spain both a bookshop and a piece of furniture full of shelves for books. Not a library (biblioteca).

examples.text: Compro el libro en la librería de la esquina.
examples.trans: I buy the book at the bookshop on the corner.

examples.text: Tenemos una librería grande en el salón.
examples.trans: We have a big bookcase in the living room.

meanings.note: Fruit tree bearing lemons (el limón -> el limonero).

examples.text: El limonero está aquí.
examples.trans: The lemon tree is here.

examples.text: Vemos los limoneros desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the lemon trees from the door.

meanings.note: Opposite of sucio (dirty).

examples.text: Es una pieza limpia.
examples.trans: It is a clean piece.

examples.text: Aquí tiene un paño limpio y agua fría, Ernesto.
examples.trans: Here is a clean cloth and cold water, Ernesto.

meanings.note: A shopping list is la lista de la compra.

examples.text: Hago la lista de la compra.
examples.trans: I'm making the shopping list.

examples.text: Tu nombre no está en la lista.
examples.trans: Your name isn't on the list.

meanings.note: With estar, means 'ready / all set'; with ser, means 'smart'.

examples.text: El té caliente ya está listo.
examples.trans: The hot tea is ready now.

examples.text: Es una arquitecta muy lista.
examples.trans: She is a very smart architect.

meanings.note: Preterite 1st sg spells g -> gu: llegué.

examples.text: Siempre llego diez minutos temprano.
examples.trans: I always arrive ten minutes early.

examples.text: El tren de Madrid llegó en punto.
examples.trans: The train from Madrid arrived on the dot.

meanings.note: Describes a sunny morning or airy room.

examples.text: Es una pieza luminosa.
examples.trans: It is a bright piece.

examples.text: Qué mañana tan luminosa
examples.trans: What a bright morning

meanings.note: De madera = wooden.

examples.text: La madera está aquí.
examples.trans: The wood is here.

examples.text: Vemos las maderas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the woods from the door.

meanings.note: Nada mal = not bad at all; menos mal = thank goodness.

examples.text: Nada mal para el primer día.
examples.trans: Not bad at all for the first day.

examples.text: ¡Menos mal que trajiste paraguas!
examples.trans: Thank goodness you brought an umbrella!

meanings.note: Ordinarily masculine in everyday speech (el mar Mediterráneo, salado como el mar), though poetic/seafaring Spanish also uses la mar.

examples.text: Esta cucharada del tarro blanco sabe salada como el mar.
examples.trans: This spoonful from the white jar tastes as salty as the sea.

examples.text: Desde la colina del parque se ve brillar el mar a lo lejos.
examples.trans: From the park hill you can see the sea shining in the distance.

meanings.note: First-person singular object/reflexive pronoun.

examples.text: ¿Me pasas la sal, por favor?
examples.trans: Can you pass me the salt, please?

examples.text: Vivo aquí y trabajo aquí.
examples.trans: I live here and I work here.

meanings.note: Por lo menos = at least; echar de menos = to miss; a menos que = unless.

examples.text: Son las ocho menos diez.
examples.trans: It is ten to eight.

examples.text: Por lo menos ya no llueve.
examples.trans: At least it is no longer raining.

meanings.note: Agrees with the noun it describes.
In ahora mismo, meaning right now, mismo strengthens the time word ahora. Now comes from ahora; mismo supplies emphasis without agreeing with a person in this expression.

examples.text: Tenemos el mismo trabajo.
examples.trans: We have the same job.

examples.text: Ahora mismo estoy ocupada.
examples.trans: I am busy right now.

meanings.note: Describes a mystery caller or note.

examples.text: Es una pieza misteriosa.
examples.trans: It is a mysterious piece.

examples.text: Pues claro que vine. ¿Por qué te escondiste detrás de una nota misteriosa?
examples.trans: Of course I came. Why did you hide behind a mystery note?

meanings.note: Invariable in plural: el miércoles, los miércoles.

examples.text: El miércoles está aquí.
examples.trans: The Wednesday is here.

examples.text: Vemos los miércoles desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the Wednesdays from the door.

meanings.note: Placed directly before the verb (or object pronouns) to negate a sentence.

examples.text: Hoy no llueve en Valencia.
examples.trans: Today it is not raining in Valencia.

examples.text: No se preocupe por la hora.
examples.trans: Do not worry about the time.

meanings.note: ¡Buenas noches! = Good evening / Good night; esta noche = tonight.

examples.text: La noche está aquí.
examples.trans: The night is here.

examples.text: Vemos las noches desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the nights from the door.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender and number with the thing possessed (nuestro patio, nuestra posada).

examples.text: Nuestra posada tiene ocho habitaciones.
examples.trans: Our guesthouse has eight rooms.

examples.text: Nuestros vecinos toman café aquí.
examples.trans: Our neighbours have coffee here.

meanings.note: De nuevo is an idiom meaning 'again'.

examples.text: Es una pieza nueva.
examples.trans: It is a new piece.

examples.text: ¡Ah, se abre! Gracias. Soy Clara, la nueva recepcionista.
examples.trans: Oh, it opens! Thank you. I am Clara, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Same form for masculine and feminine singular; plural oficiales.

examples.text: Mañana recibimos la carta oficial del ayuntamiento.
examples.trans: Tomorrow we receive the official letter from City Hall.

examples.text: Hoy es la apertura oficial de nuestra sala de té.
examples.trans: Today is the official opening of our tea room.

meanings.note: Marks destination, recipient (para ti), deadline, and minutes to the hour (cinco para las doce).

examples.text: Este paquete blanco es para mi hermano.
examples.trans: This white parcel is for my brother.

examples.text: Faltan diez minutos para las doce.
examples.trans: It is ten minutes to twelve.

meanings.note: Traditional inner courtyard at the heart of a Spanish building.

examples.text: El patio está aquí.
examples.trans: The courtyard is here.

examples.text: Vemos los patios desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the courtyards from the door.

meanings.note: Past-participle adjective from pintar.

examples.text: Es una pieza pintada.
examples.trans: It is a painted piece.

examples.text: Solo una llave dorada pintada encima de la puerta. Enséñale esta válvula al dependiente.
examples.trans: Only a painted golden key above the door. Show the clerk this valve.

poner.gloss: to put; to set; to become (ponerse + adj)

meanings.en: to put; to set; to become (ponerse + adj)
meanings.note: Irregular: pongo, pon, puse, puesto; ponerse nervioso = get nervous.

examples.text: Pongo dos tazas limpias en la mesa.
examples.trans: I put two clean cups on the table.

examples.text: Pon la maleta junto al mostrador.
examples.trans: Set the suitcase beside the counter.

por.gloss: through; along; by; because of; in (time of day)

meanings.en: through; along; by; because of; in (time of day)
meanings.note: Por la mañana = in the morning; por favor = please; gracias por = thanks for.

examples.text: Paseamos por el casco antiguo.
examples.trans: We stroll through the old quarter.

examples.text: Por la mañana entra mucho sol.
examples.trans: In the morning plenty of sun comes in.

meanings.note: Augmentative of puerta; drops the written accent in plural portones.

examples.text: Colgamos el cartel de madera junto al portón principal.
examples.trans: We hung the wooden sign beside the main front gate.

examples.text: El portón de la calle se cierra a las diez.
examples.trans: The street gate closes at ten o'clock.

punto.gloss: dot; point (en punto = on the dot; a punto de = about to)

meanings.en: dot; point (en punto = on the dot; a punto de = about to)
meanings.note: A las nueve en punto = at nine o'clock sharp.

examples.text: El punto está aquí.
examples.trans: The dot is here.

examples.text: Vemos los puntos desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the dots from the door.

meanings.note: Core connector and relative pronoun (unaccented, distinct from interrogative qué).

examples.text: Espero que descanses muy bien.
examples.trans: I hope that you rest very well.

examples.text: El pan de esta panadería huele genial.
examples.trans: The bread that The baker bakes smells great.

meanings.note: Stem-changing o -> ue in present (resuelvo, resuelve) with irregular past participle resuelto / resuelta ('resolved / solved').

examples.text: Con dos etiquetas rojas resolvimos el lío del azúcar y la sal.
examples.trans: With two red labels we solved the mix-up between the sugar and the salt.

examples.text: ¡Crisis resuelta! Ya está todo listo para mañana por la mañana.
examples.trans: Crisis resolved! Everything is ready now for tomorrow morning.

meanings.note: Drops the written accent mark in the plural (las revisiones).

examples.text: La revisión municipal del café es el miércoles a las tres en punto.
examples.trans: The city inspection of the café is on Wednesday at three o'clock sharp.

examples.text: El técnico vino por la mañana para hacer la revisión de la caldera.
examples.trans: The technician came in the morning to do the boiler check-up.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender and number.

examples.text: Es una pieza roja.
examples.trans: It is a red piece.

examples.text: ¡Dígales que la mía tiene una cinta roja en el bolsillo de arriba!
examples.trans: Tell them mine has a red ribbon in the top pocket!

meanings.note: Sala de conciertos = concert hall; sala de la caldera = boiler room.

examples.text: La sala está aquí.
examples.trans: The hall is here.

examples.text: Vemos las salas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the halls from the door.

meanings.note: Opposite of dulce.

examples.text: Es una pieza salada.
examples.trans: It is a salty piece.

examples.text: ¿Podemos servir mantequilla salada con mermelada dulce de fresa?
examples.trans: Can we serve salted butter with sweet strawberry jam?

saltar.gloss: to jump; to spark / pop on

meanings.en: to jump; to spark / pop on
meanings.note: Ahí salta la llama = there goes the flame.

examples.text: El niño salta los charcos de lluvia.
examples.trans: The boy jumps over the rain puddles.

examples.text: De pronto saltó la chispa azul.
examples.trans: Suddenly the blue spark jumped on.

meanings.note: Seguro que... = I bet / probably...

examples.text: Es una pieza segura.
examples.trans: It is a sure piece.

examples.text: ¿Está segura? ¡Parece preciosa y muy calentita!
examples.trans: Are you sure? It looks lovely and nice and warm!

meanings.note: Las seis = six o'clock.

examples.text: Me despierto a las seis y media.
examples.trans: I wake up at six thirty.

examples.text: Tengo seis limones en la cesta.
examples.trans: I have six lemons in the basket.

meanings.note: Postage stamp or official ink stamp.

examples.text: El sello está aquí.
examples.trans: The stamp is here.

examples.text: Vemos los sellos desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the stamps from the door.

ser.gloss: to be (identity, origin, time, permanent trait)

meanings.en: to be (identity, origin, time, permanent trait)
meanings.note: Used for names, professions, ownership (es mía), materials (es de madera), and clock time.

examples.text: Soy arquitecta y vivo en Valencia.
examples.trans: I am an architect and live in Valencia.

examples.text: Esa maleta azul es mía.
examples.trans: That blue suitcase is mine.

meanings.note: Wooden or folding chair.

examples.text: La silla está aquí.
examples.trans: The chair is here.

examples.text: Vemos las sillas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the chairs from the door.

sobre.gloss: on; upon; about; out of (nueve sobre diez)

meanings.en: on; upon; about; out of (nueve sobre diez)
meanings.note: Sobre todo = above all / mostly; also a homograph noun el sobre ('envelope').

examples.text: Deja la llave sobre el mostrador.
examples.trans: Leave the key on the counter.

examples.text: Sacó nueve sobre diez en la prueba.
examples.trans: She scored nine out of ten on the test.

solo.gloss: only; just (also adj solo/sola = alone / single)

meanings.en: only; just (also adj solo/sola = alone / single)
meanings.note: Unaccented in modern RAE spelling; café solo = black espresso.

examples.text: Solo necesito cinco minutos más.
examples.trans: I only need five more minutes.

examples.text: Queda una sola habitación libre.
examples.trans: Only a single room remains vacant.

meanings.note: Everyday word in Spain for a jam or honey jar.

examples.text: Guardamos la mermelada casera en tarros de cristal.
examples.trans: We keep the homemade jam in glass jars.

examples.text: Abre el tarro grande de miel con cuidado.
examples.trans: Open the big jar of honey carefully.

meanings.note: Object/reflexive pronoun corresponding to tú.

examples.text: Te guardo un rollo de canela.
examples.trans: I am saving a cinnamon roll for you.

examples.text: ¿Cómo te llamas?
examples.trans: What is your name?

meanings.note: Todo el día = the whole day; todo el mundo = everyone; sobre todo = mostly.

examples.text: Todo está limpio y en su sitio.
examples.trans: Everything is clean and in its place.

examples.text: Camina todo recto por esta calle.
examples.trans: Walk straight ahead down this street.

meanings.note: Invariable cardinal number.

examples.text: Ponemos tres mesas bajo el árbol.
examples.trans: We set three tables under the tree.

examples.text: Empieza con tres frases cortas.
examples.trans: Start with three short sentences.

meanings.note: Accented té ('tea') distinguishes the noun from pronoun te ('you').

examples.text: El té está aquí.
examples.trans: The tea is here.

examples.text: Vemos los tés desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the teas from the door.

meanings.note: Natural exclamation of effort, relief, or sudden heat/rain.

examples.text: ¡Uf, cuánto pesa esta contraventana de madera maciza!
examples.trans: Whew, how heavy this solid wood shutter is!

examples.text: ¡Uf, entramos en el pasillo justo antes del chaparrón!
examples.trans: Phew, we got into the hallway right before the downpour!

meanings.note: Shortens to un before masculine singular nouns.

examples.text: Toma uno recién salido del horno.
examples.trans: Take one fresh out of the oven.

examples.text: Contamos del uno al ocho.
examples.trans: We count from one to eight.

meanings.note: Feminine: la vecina.

examples.text: El vecino está aquí.
examples.trans: The neighbour is here.

examples.text: Vemos los vecinos desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the neighbours from the door.

meanings.note: Una ventana soleada = a sunny window.

examples.text: La ventana está aquí.
examples.trans: The window is here.

examples.text: Vemos las ventanas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the windows from the door.

meanings.note: Changes to e before words starting with /i/ sound (i- or hi-).

examples.text: Servimos café caliente y pan fresco.
examples.trans: We serve hot coffee and fresh bread.

examples.text: Son las siete y cuarto.
examples.trans: It is quarter past seven.
